description: This file implements the CMAgent class which provides an interface for managing a device or component via various wrapper functions for getting, setting, and managing parameters, attributes, health, and sessions. It includes functions for initialization, pre/post prerequisites, parameter management, table object management, health checks, and session handling, utilizing external C functions for underlying operations.

classes.name: CMAgent
classes.description: A class to manage device parameters, attributes, health, session, and table objects via wrapper functions, supporting initialization, cleanup, and various management operations.

methods.name: bool initialize(IN const char * szVersion)
methods.description: Initializes the CMAgent by registering the wrapper method with the agent.

methods.name: std::string testmodulepre_requisites()
methods.description: Sets up pre-requisites necessary for the component, calling ssp_register.

methods.name: void CMAgent_Get(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values using ssp_getParameterValue and populates the response.

methods.name: void CMAgent_Set(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Sets a parameter value using ssp_setParameterValue based on the request.

methods.name: void CMAgent_Set_Get(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Performs a set followed by a get operation to validate parameter setting.

methods.name: void CMAgent_GetAttr(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves attribute information for a parameter.

methods.name: void CMAgent_SetAttr(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Sets attribute information for a parameter.

methods.name: void CMAgent_GetNames(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves parameter names under a given component path.

methods.name: void CMAgent_AddObject(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Adds a new row (object) in a table parameter.

methods.name: void CMAgent_DelObject(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Deletes a row (object) from a table parameter.

methods.name: void CMAgent_SetCommit(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Commits changes in a table object.

methods.name: void CMAgent_GetHealth(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves the health status of a component.

methods.name: void CMAgent_SetSessionId(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Sets a session ID with specified priority, session ID, and override flag.
